title: attacktree tree
description: An attack tree or decision tree in the attacktree / Deciduous YAML format. Docs: /llms-full.txt

title.description: Shown in the editor and on exports.

facts.description: True statements about the system that are neither attacks nor defenses.

goals.description: What the attacker ultimately wants. Drawn at the bottom.

filter.description: Show only the paths that go through these nodes.

positions.description: Nodes placed by hand on the canvas: id -> [x, y]. Written by the editor.

id.description: Unique across the whole tree. Prefer letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter. 'reality' is the implicit root.

node.description: The FIRST key is the node id and its value is the label (empty = derived from the id). The only other key is 'from'.

from.description: Ids this node comes from; arrows point from them to this node.

oneOf.description: The FIRST key is the source id; its value is an optional label such as '#yolosec'. Flags follow as sibling keys.

backwards.description: A mitigation sends the attacker back to this earlier step.

implemented.description: false = planned, not in place yet.

anyOf.description: Flags nested under the id are accepted too.
